data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiencies
data.description: A magical child is not proficient with medium armor. She can cast summoner spells (see spellcasting below) while wearing light armor without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. This alters the vigilante's armor and weapon proficiencies.
